_readme: Campaign inventory catalogue (Campaign Foundation T10). Loaded by InventoryCatalogueAsset; InventoryCatalogue.BuiltIn() holds the same data as a fallback.
items: id (stable, saved), label, category (Profiles | Case Files | Tools & Supplies | Keepsakes), icon (HudIconArt picture: notes, folder, profiles, book),
description (press-and-hold details card), required (never in the drawer, never left behind), stackLimit (1 = one per slot),
container (one slot holds them all: profiles in the binder, case papers and the Client Copy in the folder),
scope (the story level the item belongs to; a fresh run of that level clears it), returnsToWorld (closing Make room puts it back, e.g. the desk book).
journal: neutral facts the evidence journal lists once learned; sourceItemId is the record it links to. Never an answer or a conclusion.
Content rule (checked by the regression suite): a level never needs more required items at once than the starting 3 + 5 slots.
carryLimit (T11): at most this many carried in bar + bag together; more are refused (0 = no limit). scope "" = kept for the whole campaign.

items.label: Profile Binder
items.description: Every taxpayer profile you collect, kept together in one binder.

items.label: Notes
items.description: Today's objectives and every step, ticked off as you go.

items.label: Case Folder
items.description: Your client's case papers. Hand it to the Auditor from your bar.

items.label: Tax Code Book
items.description: The rules, section by section. Read it anywhere; it can go back on its desk stand.

items.label: Coast Tales Postcard
items.description: A postcard of the island coast with a short note on the back. Display it on the stand at your desk.

items.label: Review Voucher
items.description: A folded green ticket with a copper clock seal: +180 REVIEW SECONDS on one case, before the Auditor leaves. One per case; you can carry two.

items.label: Bookmark Set
items.description: Three leather ribbon pins. Pin up to three records to the top of your Bag; every record stays free to read.
